profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ingram Content Group
profile.summary:
Visual Studio, MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle, DB2, Git, Azure, Linux, Tibco MQ, MS Office
C#.Net, MVC, JavaScript, Angular, HTML, CSS, ASP, C++, C, VB6, Java

positions.title: Software Engineer Intermediate
positions.description:
Modernized monolithic apps using .NET Core APIs and Angular front end
Develop enhancements providing users with self-service functionalities speeding up turn-around time from a 4-5 days down to same-day
Maintained and developed ssis packages for ETL process
Manage software used to take in, distribute, and archive documents from across the company
Dev lead working with offshore team to distribute development tasks and provide direction
Investigate and resolve bugs in .NET applications to ensure optimal development environment
Drive the conversion to Azure CI/CD for the group and using azure libraries for saving secrets
Provide production support solving issues quickly to minimize downtime

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain website providing reporting for the accounting department to track inventory and financial statements 
Application development in C# for the strategic pricing platform that provides predictive suggestions for title pricing to optimize margins that lead to $2MM in profits
Configure and maintain continuous deployments with Bamboo and Octopus

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop C# applications for a digital library provider specializing in the academic market 
Design and modify the software to allow management of library and customer accounts
Develop angular mobile site allowing over ½ million titles to be read online or downloaded to a computer, mobile and tablet devices.

positions.title: Advanced Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Application development in C# for real-time automated fulfillment systems at warehouse distribution facilities 
Configure and coordinate testing of systems at all new locations
Develop and maintain website allowing personnel to configure new and existing systems remotely
Manage telephony system used for over the phone ordering bringing in $1MM in sales

positions.title: Senior Software Programmer
positions.description:
Application development in C++ and C# for real-time automated fulfillment systems at mail order pharmacies
Maintain and develop reports used by QA and management for statistical analysis
Standardize database tables in order to facilitate inventory tracking for product usage and cost analysis across five CMOP facilities
Design and modify the software to allow management a means to easily access archived data that before was not readily available
Develop the interface for new devices combining the scanner and weight scale to expedite the product packaging process
Convert server applications into Windows services to simplify management for domain administrators
Develop and modify the packaging system to handle new hardware that increased document printing speed by 47%  improving productivity at all customer locations

positions.title: Software Programmer/Project Coordinator
positions.description:
Developed applications in VB6 for Just-In-Time manufacturing system used by automotive manufacturer suppliers
Designed and modified application user interfaces to optimize user experience
Configured software to customer specifications consistently delivering on time and under budget
Co-lead the acquisition of new projects worth more than $1MM
Provided software training sessions to provide customers with a better understanding of the features and functions
Solved user end problems in a production support capacity in a quick and timely manner to minimize downtime

positions.title: Process Controls Engineer
positions.description:
Developed user interfaces for manufacturing system to replace the outdated hardware and software system reducing the overhead of maintenance
Consolidated operator control rooms to centralized locations
Delivered solution to quickly and efficiently deploy application changes across the facility
Managed controlled updates for operations vital servers and workstations on the network

positions.title: Process Controls Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
Developed user interfaces for manufacturing system to replace the outdated hardware and software system reducing the overhead of maintenance
Consolidated operator control rooms to centralized locations
Delivered solution to quickly and efficiently deploy application changes across the facility
Managed controlled updates for operations vital servers and workstations on the network
